# Weather and status effects

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_effects_table.py from weather_defs.lua. Do not edit by hand. -->

Values are at full intensity. During a transition every modifier blends in: `effective = 1 + (mod - 1) × intensity`, and the `weather_effect_scale` modoption is meant to scale them further. Night stacks on top of whatever the weather is.

> **Status:** the weather itself cycles in game, but no effect gadgets exist yet (Phase 4+). These are the planned values; the HUD only lists a modifier once its system is live.

## Who wins

| Condition | Favors | Hurts |
|---|---|---|
| **Clear** | Air and artillery (golden window), solar | Nobody |
| **Overcast** | Wind | Solar (slightly) |
| **Rain** | Bots, hover and amphibious units, tidal | Vehicles on low ground (mud), solar |
| **Storm** | Wind economy, ground pushes while enemy air is weak | Air, solar, tall structures (lightning) |
| **Fog** | Raiders, flankers, radar, whoever holds high ground | Static defenses, long-range direct fire |
| **Snow** | Defenders, turtles, builders who planned ahead | Fast raiders, attacking up slopes |
| **Night** | Stealthy raids, scouts, holding fire | Solar, unscouted armies |

## Modifiers

`×` values are multipliers; ✔ marks an on/off mechanic; – means unaffected.

| Effect | System | Clear | Overcast | Rain | Storm | Fog | Snow | Night |

| Air line of sight | vision | 1.1× | – | – | 0.7× | – | – | – |

| Aircraft speed | movement | – | – | 0.95× | 0.8× | – | – | – |

| Vehicle speed | movement | – | – | – | 0.95× | – | 0.85× | – |

| Ship speed | movement | – | – | – | 0.9× | – | – | – |

| Tidal output | economy | – | – | 1.15× | – | – | – | – |

## Atmosphere

| Weather | Precipitation | Cloud | Fog | Wind (min–max) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clear | 0 | 0.1 | 0 | 0–10 |
| Overcast | 0 | 0.7 | 0.1 | 3–15 |
| Rain | 0.6 | 0.8 | 0.2 | 5–18 |
| Storm | 1 | 1 | 0.3 | 15–30 |
| Fog | 0 | 0.5 | 0.9 | 0–4 |
| Snow | 0.5 | 0.8 | 0.3 | 2–12 |

## Climates
